title: Incline Dumbbell Y-Raise
summary: A chest-down Y-raise on an incline bench for the lower traps and rear delts.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for traps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.6 for rear delts (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.
Library rating 0.5 for side delts (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly side delts total.

setup.text: Lie face down on a bench at 30 to 45 degrees holding light dumbbells.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y with your thumbs up.

form_cues.cue: Raise the arms in a Y shape
Very light weight. Squeeze the shoulder blades down and back.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Similar muscles; dumbbell instead of dumbbell.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable, Steadier cable tension.
